readings.Aries: There's a difference between courage and combustion. Today the line is thinner than usual. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Taurus: You are more afraid of loss than you are excited by gain. This shapes every choice you make. Let this one be easy.
readings.Gemini: Your wit is a gift. It's also where you go when you don't want to be known. The first instinct was right.
readings.Cancer: Something is asking to be mourned before it can be moved past. Let it. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Leo: Your instinct to lead is correct. Your instinct to control the entire outcome needs recalibrating. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Virgo: Something you wrote off as not worth your time deserves a second look with less judgment. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Libra: Your sense of fairness is exquisite. It is occasionally applied in situations where it doesn't belong. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Scorpio: Your perceptiveness is remarkable and occasionally used as a weapon. Today, use it as a gift. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Sagittarius: You hold ideas loosely, which is beautiful. Hold the people in your life a little less loosely. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Capricorn: You are more than your output. This requires repeating. Let this one be easy.
readings.Aquarius: Your idealism is not naïveté. It is a choice. Keep choosing it, but with your eyes open. The first instinct was right.
readings.Pisces: There is more groundedness in you than your fluidness suggests. Access it today. The window for this is shorter than it looks.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
